column1: # Reviewed identifier backfill from Studio telemetry (AUREO-1227).
# Read by `pnpm identifiers:apply --rows`.
# target<TAB>format<TAB>identifier<TAB>version<TAB>source
#   identifier `-` adds the format alone, for an entry that already holds the
#   right id under a key the build can resolve but lists no format to put it on.
# Source is one macOS release CSV (2026-09-09 sync, 223 unmatched plugins on one
# machine, 12 users in the export). Every row below is an entry that already
# exists under the right manufacturer and carried no identifier for the scanned
# format, matched on name after normalisation. The version column is left empty
# deliberately: an installed build is one machine's state, not release history,
# and `add-telemetry-versions.ts` is the lane for that. 190 of the 223 needed no
# row at all, their identifiers already resolve since catalog#860.
# Rejected, and why a probe cannot take them:
#   sonible-smartreverb-2      com.sonible.smartreverb       — scan is smart:reverb 1 (v1.1.2), only v2 is in the catalog
#   sonible-smartcomp-3        com.sonible.smartcomp2        — scan is smart:comp 2, only v3 is in the catalog
# Settled on review 2026-09-26 and written by hand:
#   waves-intrigger-drum-replacer  com.WavesAudio.InTriggerLive  — a component every InTrigger licence ships, now in componentIdentifiers
#   waves-nx-germano-studios-new-york  com.WavesAudio.NxGermanoStudios  — the Germano room, sold on its own; `waves-nx` is a different product
# Collection-vs-member: UAD ships one binary per member of a "Collection"
# entry and `identifiers` holds one value per format. Resolved 2026-09-26 by
# `componentIdentifiers` (CLAUDE.md "Identifiers"), written by hand:
#   universal-audio-1176-classic-limiter-collection    U39V / U39X / U39Z (Rev A, LN Rev E, AE)
#   universal-audio-fairchild-tube-limiter-collection  U3AV (670) beside U3AX
#   universal-audio-teletronix-la-2a-tube-compressor   U3A7 primary (Gray), U3A5 / U3A9 (LA-2, Silver)
#   universal-audio-manley-massive-passive             U391 (base EQ) beside U393 (MST)
#   universal-audio-topline-vocal-suite                UI14 beside UI13
#   universal-audio-hitsville-reverb-chambers          U3D7 beside U3D5
sonible-smartgate
sonible-truebalance
sonible-smarteq-4
waves-j37-tape
waves-emo-generator
universal-audio-polymax-synth
# Already holds `default: com.uaudio.effects.U3CY` and lists no formats, so the
# build writes the id onto no row and the matcher cannot reach it. vst3 is the
# format the scan observed; au and aax are not added because nothing here
# observed them.
universal-audio-api-vision-channel-strip-collection
